import json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts import run_native_transit_fresh_transfer_stage242 as transfer
from freq_hrl.domains.transit.native_frozen_future import conditional_mc
from freq_hrl.experiments.pointmaze_root_response import write_json
_,fresh=transfer.learning.read_panel_cache(transfer.panel_path("native_transit_fresh_transfer_stage242_development_20261015_r1"))

cells=[c for c in sealed["cells"] if c["key"][0].startswith("mixed")]
pooled=conditional_mc(cells,fresh)
by_root={str(root):conditional_mc([{"blocks":[b for b in c["blocks"] if b["held_group"][0]==root]} for c in cells],fresh) for root in transfer.source.ROOTS}

maximum=max(abs(pooled["variants"][v]["fields"][f]["mean"]-reference["mixed_pooled"]["fresh8"]["all"]["variants"][v][g]) for v in transfer.learning.VARIANTS for f,g in (("cost","delta_cost"),("wait_min","delta_wait_min")))
if maximum>1e-12: raise ValueError("Conditional MC duplicate weighting changed pooled mean")
reg=next(c for c in cells if tuple(c["key"])==transfer.source.prior.REGRESSION_KEY)
result={"protocol":"native_transit_conditional_mc_stage241_v1","software_qualified":True,"posthoc":True,"source_run":transfer.SOURCE_RUN,"panel_run":"native_transit_fresh_transfer_stage242_development_20261015_r1","mixed_pooled":pooled,"by_root":by_root,"regression_case":conditional_mc([reg],fresh),"mean_reproduction_max_abs_difference":maximum,"new_native_episodes":0,"training_updates":0,"default_changed":False}
write_json(transfer.ROOT/"results"/"native_transit_conditional_mc_stage241_development_20261015_r1"/"report/result.json",result)
print("CONDITIONAL_MC_COMPLETE",flush=True)
